reasoning_content:
Both are currently running. Let's wait a bit and then poll. `infra-up` runs `_compose up -d`, and the following environment variables are needed: APP_HOST, BIND_ADDR, TRAEFIK_CONFIG, TRAEFIK_ENTRYPOINT, APP_PROTO, APP_PORT, PORKBUN_API_KEY, PORKBUN_SECRET_API_KEY, APP_VERSION, APP_GIT_COMMIT, APP_GIT_BRANCH, APP_BUILD_TIME.

Note: `_compose` runs `docker compose {{ ARGS }}`. When you run `docker compose up -d` without a profile, only the infra services (keycloak, keycloak-init-db, db, pgadmin, streamlet, valhalla, reverse-proxy) are started, and backend/frontend/migrations (the app profile) are not started.

Wait a bit, then check the infra status.

action.command: sleep 150; echo "=== infra.log ==="; tail -30 /tmp/infra.log; echo; echo "=== docker ps ==="; docker ps --format "table {{.Names}}\t{{.Status}}" 2>&1
